scope: GHCR distribution foundation: eleven direct Rust crates, Rust/Go toolchains, SDK graph, container inputs, pinned BuildKit and SBOM generator, and release Actions. Platform and registry execution evidence is tracked separately from workflow configuration.

freshness_check.follow_up: BuildKit and the official stable-1 SBOM generator join the daily container freshness gate. Native OS runtime/build-tool versions remain tied to the recorded hosted runner environment; complete native archive and remote GHCR execution is pending.

direct_dependencies.name: serde_json
direct_dependencies.purpose: Read ledger, bounded runtime configuration and official dependency metadata without a general schema engine.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official publisher release v1.0.154 published 2026-10-11; actively maintained.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Cargo.lock records the full graph; newest stable direct release verified independently of the manifest range.

direct_dependencies.name: tokio
direct_dependencies.purpose: Bounded async runtime, sockets, signals, synchronization and deadlines.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Newest stable checked independently of manifest ranges; no previous runtime version to migrate.

direct_dependencies.name: hyper
direct_dependencies.purpose: HTTP/1 server with explicit connection admission, parser bounds and graceful drain.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: No HTTP/2, TLS or client features; latest stable direct release independently verified.

direct_dependencies.name: hyper-util
direct_dependencies.purpose: Official Tokio I/O and timer adapters for Hyper.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Only Tokio adapters enabled; no extra server framework.

direct_dependencies.name: http-body-util
direct_dependencies.purpose: JSON/probe bodies, capped 64 KiB bucket metadata collection and bounded streaming media response channels.

direct_dependencies.name: rusqlite
direct_dependencies.purpose: Indexed transactional bucket/object catalog with bundled SQLite, durable generation allocation, WAL recovery and atomic mutation preconditions.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official rusqlite publisher; latest non-yanked stable verified from the crates.io index on 2026-10-21.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Default features disabled; bundled SQLite only. Cargo.lock pins libsqlite3-sys 0.38.2 and the full graph; no cache, pooling or extension features. No rust-version is declared by the crate.

direct_dependencies.name: bytes
direct_dependencies.purpose: Shared bounded byte chunks across HTTP, upload channels and disk readers.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official publisher; latest non-yanked stable and active upstream development verified on 2026-10-21.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Already used transitively by Hyper/Tokio; direct use shares their Bytes type without a second buffering layer.

direct_dependencies.name: md-5
direct_dependencies.purpose: Incremental Google-compatible object MD5 checksums; not used for authentication or signatures.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: RustCrypto publisher; latest non-yanked stable and active upstream development verified on 2026-10-21.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Default features disabled; the digest graph is pinned in Cargo.lock.

direct_dependencies.name: crc32c
direct_dependencies.purpose: Incremental Castagnoli CRC32C validation with bounded object chunks.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official publisher; latest non-yanked stable and active upstream development verified on 2026-10-21.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: One small checksum crate instead of a general hashing/codec framework; no rust-version declared.

direct_dependencies.name: getrandom
direct_dependencies.purpose: Opaque random blob IDs independent of untrusted object names.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official publisher; latest non-yanked stable and active upstream development verified on 2026-10-21.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Operating-system randomness only; no UUID format, parser or extra options.

direct_dependencies.name: windows-sys
direct_dependencies.purpose: Windows-only write-through blob publication and console process-group control in integration tests.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Microsoft-maintained windows-rs bindings; official registry's newest stable non-yanked release verified 2026-10-22.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Already locked transitively with windows-link 0.2.1; direct use only on Windows, with console/threading features limited to tests. No additional package version is introduced.

digests.update_scope: Both 1.99.1-slim-trixie and slim-trixie resolve to this index. The amd64/arm64 platform manifests remain unchanged; Dockerfile now pins the updated index.

digests.purpose: Shell-free glibc/libgcc runtime for the existing GNU Rust binary. USER remains 10001:10001 for persistent-volume compatibility; the nonroot tag's default user is overridden.
digests.alias_note: The nonroot tag tracks updates within Debian 13. Debian stable codename is checked independently so a newer Debian generation is detected.

digests.purpose: Test-only peer-container curl in scripts/smoke-containers.sh; not shipped in the runtime image.
Pinned native container builder for GHCR publication, SBOM and provenance. The floating latest selector detects new stable image inputs.
Pinned official BuildKit SBOM generator; stable-1 replacement is checked daily.

docker.reason: Official multiarch manifest indexes from Docker Hub and public GCR; floating selectors, pinned tags and Debian stable codename are checked for replacement. Local amd64 execution uses emulation on an arm64 Docker host; native CI execution is pending.

direct_dependencies.name: cloud.google.com/go/storage
direct_dependencies.purpose: Official HTTP JSON bucket lifecycle and pagination compatibility tests.

direct_dependencies.name: google.golang.org/api
direct_dependencies.purpose: Official client options, pagination and JSON API error types.

sdk_ecosystems.resolution_constraints: go.mod and go.sum record the graph. The latest stable API client requires an auth pseudo-version; transitive versions follow upstream requirements. Freshness checks cover every direct require, excluding prereleases and retractions from the highest release's go.mod.
